title: Cost-effectiveness Study of Beclomethasone Versus Ciclesonide as Controller Medications in Pediatric Asthma
brief_summary: The Objective was to Develop a Cost-Effectiveness study that compares Ciclesonide and Beclomethasone in pediatric asthma control.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with uncontrolled asthma diagnosis
* Patients with only one controller medication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without lung infection
* Patients without antibiotic use
